description: Pinned inputs and per-place sources of the canon's own geometries (D062, R047). build.py rebuilds the GeoJSON files and sources.csv from this file.

holder_point.source: register fact siachen / wd_coordinates (Wikidata Q333946, P625, read 2026-10-03): the Siachen Glacier, held by India (siachen / holder)

places.notes: No party publishes the line up to which India holds the glacier, so the land is divided by the best available line of control (D066): OSM's India-Pakistan line north of the end of the agreed Line of Control, taken from the ways of the relation 'Siachen Glacier Disputed Area' (13559521) tagged Line of Control, which run along the Saltoro Ridge to the China border. Both ends are prolonged by 0.02° (about 2 km) so the line crosses GADM's own line; the result is the same for 0.02° to 0.1°. The consumer splits Gilgit-Baltistan's units by the line and gives the side with the holder point (the glacier) to India-held Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. The OSM relation is built from OSM's own ways and only tagged with a Natural Earth id. DoS draws no such line (its Siachen polygon is a wedge of two straight lines); Natural Earth's is three vertices marked 'please verify'.
